title: Microsoft Dataverse: richer record labels for Copilot /mention in Microsoft 365 apps
summary: Hold: the briefing says Microsoft Learn does not describe authorization further, but Microsoft documents Dataverse privilege and record-access checks. Narrow that absence to the implementation of /mention suggestions. The control path, roadmap details and corrected Copilot email example are supported.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: An email recipient needs environment access and security roles granting data access to open the shared record.
claims.quote: The recipient of the email must have access to the environment with security roles that grant access to the data and must be able to access the shared record.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe the authorization mechanism further than the stated access requirements.
claims.quote: To be able to do a certain action with a table (Create, Read, Write, Delete, Append, Append to, Assign, Share), two major checks are done: privilege and access checks.
claims.fix: Replace 'Microsoft Learn does not describe the authorisation mechanism further, so test it with a user who lacks access.' with 'The /mention page does not describe how its record suggestions implement these access requirements, so test it with a user who lacks access.' The narrower absence is supported by https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/link-records-outlook-web; general Dataverse authorization is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/how-record-access-determined.
